column1: To start your beginning inventory for testing and the evaluation you have 2 options for starting your Inventory:
Using a Plant to create an immature plant batch using POST/plants/v2/plantings.
Using POST/packages/v2/plantings to create a Plant Batch from a Package.
The packages can be created with the request POST/plantbatches/v2/packages/frommotherplant and POST/plants/v2/plantbatch/packages
Another option is to use POST/plantbatches/v2/split.

Note: The request POST/plantbatches/v2/plantings will not work in California due to "CanCreateOpeningBalancePlantBatches": false, this request is used in other sandboxes that create Plant Batches from "thin air".
A date parameter WILL be needed for these calls.  You may need to contact api support for a date range
